//go:build postingedgebench && darwin

package postingedge

import (
	"context"
	"math/rand/v2"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	enterrors "github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/errors"
	ent "github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/vectorindex/postingedge"
)

// dirWatch notes, every half second, the size of every file under a
// directory, and adds up by class what the files grew by: the bytes written
// to them, but for what a file gets and loses between two looks. A file that
// shrinks (the journal, emptied) starts again from its new size.
type dirWatch struct {
	dir     string
	mu      sync.Mutex
	last    map[string]int64
	grown   map[string]int64
	looks   int
	stopped chan struct{}
	done    chan struct{}
}

func newDirWatch(t *testing.T, dir string, logger logrus.FieldLogger) *dirWatch {
	w := &dirWatch{
		dir: dir, last: map[string]int64{}, grown: map[string]int64{},
		stopped: make(chan struct{}), done: make(chan struct{}),
	}
	// What is there before counts as the start, not as written.
	require.NoError(t, w.look(false))
	enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
		defer close(w.done)
		ticker := time.NewTicker(500 * time.Millisecond)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for {
			select {
			case <-w.stopped:
				_ = w.look(true)
				return
			case <-ticker.C:
				_ = w.look(true)
			}
		}
	}, logger)
	return w
}

func (w *dirWatch) look(count bool) error {
	sizes := map[string]int64{}
	err := filepath.WalkDir(w.dir, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
				return nil
			}
			return err
		}
		if d.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		info, err := d.Info()
		if err != nil {
			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
				return nil
			}
			return err
		}
		sizes[path] = info.Size()
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	w.looks++
	for path, size := range sizes {
		before, seen := w.last[path]
		if !seen && !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".tmp") {
			// The store writes a segment to a .tmp file and renames it: what
			// the .tmp was seen to grow by is counted already, and the rest,
			// written between two looks, is counted here.
			before = w.grown[path+".tmp"]
		}
		if count && size > before {
			w.grown[path] += size - before
		}
		w.last[path] = size
	}
	for path := range w.last {
		if _, ok := sizes[path]; !ok {
			delete(w.last, path)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (w *dirWatch) stop() map[string]int64 {
	close(w.stopped)
	<-w.done
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	return w.grown
}

var (
	segmentLevel = regexp.MustCompile(`segment-[0-9_]+\.l([0-9]+)\.`)
	vectorsGen   = regexp.MustCompile(`^(vectors|slots)-([0-9]+)\.`)
)

// classOf names what a file of the index is: a log of a bucket, a segment a
// flush wrote (level 0) or a compaction wrote (level 1 and up), the journal,
// the vectors and their slots of the generation the inserts write, those of
// a later one (a layout), and the rest.
func classOf(path string, gen int) string {
	base := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".tmp")
	switch {
	case strings.HasSuffix(base, ".wal"):
		return "lsmkv WAL"
	case strings.HasPrefix(base, "segment-"):
		if m := segmentLevel.FindStringSubmatch(base); m != nil {
			if m[1] == "0" {
				return "lsmkv flush (level 0 segments)"
			}
			return "lsmkv compaction (level 1 and up)"
		}
		return "lsmkv segments, unnamed level"
	case base == growJournalFile:
		return "journal"
	case strings.Contains(path, "commitlog"):
		return "centroid graph commit log"
	}
	if m := vectorsGen.FindStringSubmatch(base); m != nil {
		at, _ := strconv.Atoi(m[2])
		if at > gen {
			return "layout: " + m[1] + " of a new generation"
		}
		return "exact " + m[1] + " of the inserts"
	}
	return "other: " + base
}

// TestNightContinue opens a clone of the index TestNightGrow left (PE_DIR),
// over the store as a shard opens it with its cycles, and inserts PE_N more
// vectors of the night's order, from position PE_FROM, skipping the doc ids
// the index holds already (the process was killed with some of the round
// after its last stretch in), with PE_CALLERS callers. It writes to PE_OUT
// what the index counted of those inserts, what the system accounted to the
// process, and the bytes written to the files of the index by class. Run it
// with -test.cpuprofile and -test.trace for where the time went.
func TestNightContinue(t *testing.T) {
	datasetDir, dir, out := os.Getenv("PE_DATASET"), os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT")
	if datasetDir == "" || dir == "" || out == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DATASET, PE_DIR and PE_OUT given")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	train, err := openNightTrain(datasetDir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer train.file.Close()
	n := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_N", 20000))
	from := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_FROM", 3301200))
	callers := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_CALLERS", 1))

	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	uc := ent.NewDefaultUserConfig()
	uc.RQ.CacheMode = nightEnv("PE_CACHE", ent.CacheModeRouting)
	openedAt := time.Now()
	st := openNightStore(t, dir, logger, true)
	p, err := Open(st.config(dir, logger, 0), uc, st.store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	opened := time.Since(openedAt)
	shut := func() {
		if p == nil {
			return
		}
		require.NoError(t, p.Flush())
		require.NoError(t, p.Shutdown(ctx))
		st.stopCycles(ctx)
		require.NoError(t, st.store.Shutdown(ctx))
		p = nil
	}
	defer shut()

	order := make([]uint64, train.rows)
	for i := range order {
		order[i] = uint64(i)
	}
	rand.New(rand.NewPCG(1, 1)).Shuffle(len(order), func(i, j int) { order[i], order[j] = order[j], order[i] })
	p.mu.RLock()
	g := p.g
	var picked []uint64
	skipped := 0
	for i := from; i < len(order) && len(picked) < n; i++ {
		if g.holds(order[i]) {
			skipped++
			continue
		}
		picked = append(picked, order[i])
	}
	before, journalRecords, journalBytes := g.stats, g.journal.records, g.journal.bytes
	gen, live, postings := int(g.meta.VectorGen), g.meta.Live, g.meta.Postings
	p.mu.RUnlock()
	require.Len(t, picked, n)
	t.Logf("opened in %s: %d vectors, %d postings given out, generation %d of the vectors; %d doc ids after "+
		"position %d were in already", opened.Round(time.Millisecond), live, postings, gen, skipped, from)

	watch := newDirWatch(t, dir, logger)
	usageBefore, err := readNightRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var memBefore runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&memBefore)

	const batch = 100
	bufs := make([][]byte, callers)
	begin := time.Now()
	for at := 0; at < n; {
		to := min(at+batch*callers, n)
		adding := enterrors.NewErrorGroupWrapper(logger)
		for start, c := at, 0; start < to; start, c = start+batch, c+1 {
			end := min(start+batch, to)
			adding.Go(func() error {
				vectors, buf, err := train.read(picked[start:end], bufs[c])
				bufs[c] = buf
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				return p.AddBatch(ctx, picked[start:end], vectors)
			})
		}
		require.NoError(t, adding.Wait())
		require.NoError(t, p.Flush())
		at = to
	}
	took := time.Since(begin)
	usage, err := readNightRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	grown := watch.stop()

	byClass := map[string]int64{}
	var filesTotal int64
	for path, bytes := range grown {
		byClass[classOf(path, gen)] += bytes
		filesTotal += bytes
	}
	p.mu.RLock()
	g = p.g
	after := g.stats
	result := map[string]any{
		"inserted": n, "skipped": skipped, "from": from, "callers": callers, "openSeconds": opened.Seconds(),
		"seconds": took.Seconds(), "perSecond": float64(n) / took.Seconds(),
		"liveBefore": live, "postingsBefore": postings, "liveAfter": g.meta.Live, "postingsAfter": g.meta.Postings,
		"generationBefore": gen, "generationAfter": g.meta.VectorGen,
		"journalRecords": g.journal.records - journalRecords, "journalBytes": g.journal.bytes - journalBytes,
		"statsBefore": before, "statsAfter": after,
		"rusageBefore": usageBefore, "rusageAfter": usage,
		"diskBytesWritten":  usage.BytesWritten - usageBefore.BytesWritten,
		"diskBytesRead":     usage.BytesRead - usageBefore.BytesRead,
		"pageins":           usage.Pageins - usageBefore.Pageins,
		"filesGrownByClass": byClass, "filesGrownTotal": filesTotal, "looks": watch.looks,
		"heapInuseBefore": memBefore.HeapInuse,
	}
	p.mu.RUnlock()
	writeNightJSON(t, out, result)
	t.Logf("%d inserts in %s, %.1f a second; written %.2f GB (files grew %.2f GB), read %.2f GB", n,
		took.Round(time.Second), float64(n)/took.Seconds(), float64(usage.BytesWritten-usageBefore.BytesWritten)/1e9,
		float64(filesTotal)/1e9, float64(usage.BytesRead-usageBefore.BytesRead)/1e9)
	for class, bytes := range byClass {
		t.Logf("  %-44s %8.1f MB, %7.0f B an insert", class, float64(bytes)/1e6, float64(bytes)/float64(n))
	}
}
